read.en: Alphabet fell 1.1% on Oct 26 to $316.80, closing near the day's low of $316.60 after trading as high as $321.48. It is below the falling 5-day ($327.3), 10-day ($337.2), 30-day ($343.1) and 100-day ($348.1) averages and the rising 200-day ($341.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($350.09), and RSI is 29.5.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月26日下跌 1.1%，收于 $316.80，盘中最高 $321.48，收在全日低点 $316.60 附近。股价位于下行的 5 日（$327.3）、10 日（$337.2）、30 日（$343.1）和 100 日均线（$348.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$341.3）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$350.09），RSI 为 29.5。

read.en: The close broke $319.4 (Jan 21 low), now resistance, for a fifth straight lower close. Resistance is $319.4–321.5 (Jan 21 low, Oct 26 high), then $322–324.5 (Oct 22 low, Oct 23 high) and $327.3 (5-day). Support is $314.9 (Jul 23 low), then $310.3 (Jan 2 low) and $300. A close below $314.9 would open $310; a close above $321.5 would target $324.5–327.3.

r.en: Jan 21 low $319.4, now resistance; Oct 26 high $321.5
